excerpt: Data-taking years 1997, 1998, 1999 and 2001. Combined result Re(epsilon'/epsilon) = (14.7+-2.2)x10^-4. NA48 Collaboration: Cagliari, Cambridge, CERN, Dubna, Edinburgh, Ferrara, Firenze, Mainz, Orsay, Perugia, Pisa, Saclay, Siegen, Torino, Warsaw, Wien.
title: A precision measurement of epsilon'/epsilon in CP violating K0 -> 2 pi decays (the final measurement of epsilon'/epsilon by NA48)
